raw.details:
About the Organization

NEXORA is a student-led community focused on empowering aspiring professionals and innovators through opportunities in Artificial Intelligence, career development, hackathons, and technology-driven events. It aims to promote practical learning, collaboration, and innovation among students.

About the Event

PromptWars X NEXORA is an online, one-day AI-powered hackathon that brings together students from universities across India. Participants will receive a surprise problem and have a few hours to build a working AI solution using prompts, Generative AI, and prompt engineering.

Organized by NEXORA in association with Hack2Skill, as part of the Build with AI initiative and the Google for Developers ecosystem, the event encourages creativity, experimentation, and practical AI innovation.

What You Will Do

  • Receive a problem statement and challenge details on the event day.
  • Build an AI-powered solution using prompt engineering and AI-assisted development tools.
  • Experiment with Generative AI to solve real-world problems.
  • Submit your completed project through the Hack2Skill platform within the given time.
  • Showcase your creativity, problem-solving skills, and innovation.

Who can join

  • Any student aged 18+, from any college or course and professionals.
  • Beginners are welcome, and no prior AI experience is needed.
  • This is a solo challenge, so you build, submit and are evaluated individually.
  • There are no team requirements.

What you get

  • Prize pool of up to ₹50,000, based on the number of valid submissions (see the Prize section for details)
  • Official co-branded certificates for participants, finalists and winners
  • Hands-on experience building with AI under real time pressure
  • A chance to stand out in the community

Registration Step:

PromptWars x NEXORA: https://hack2skill.com/event/promptwars-x-nexora/registration?utm_source=hack2skill&utm_medium=homepage

You all have to first register on the link given above and then register on Unstop otherwise the registration will not be counted.

Join the NEXORA Navyug Community

Be a part of NEXORA Navyug, our growing WhatsApp community built for students, aspiring developers, AI enthusiasts, and future innovators.

NEXORA Navyug aims to create a collaborative environment where students can connect, learn, share opportunities, and grow together.

What you explore in our community:

- Latest updates about AI, technology, and innovation.

- Hackathons, workshops, and upcoming tech events.

- Internship opportunities, career guidance, and learning resources.

- Networking with like-minded students and aspiring developers.

- Opportunities to collaborate, share ideas, and develop new skills.

Whether you're a beginner exploring technology or an aspiring innovator looking to build something impactful, NEXORA Navyug is a place to learn, connect, and grow.

Join the Community. Connect. Learn. Build. Grow.

WhatsApp Community: [https://chat.whatsapp.com/BAs5Ffgk2Ro57NZma7eNZN]

 

Founded by: Kaushtuv Parashar

Community: NEXORA

Ready to Build?

Bring your curiosity, creativity, and ideas. Explore the power of AI, challenge yourself, and turn your imagination into something real.

Don't just learn about AI. Build with AI.

Join PromptWars X NEXORA 2026 and take your first step towards becoming a builder of tomorrow.
